senses.gloss: (cmp. זָהַהּ, cmp. זוא P. Sm. 1092) to be elated, cheerful; (in an evil sense) to be proud, overbearing.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 67b:9">Keth. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי שתָּזוּחַ דעתו עליו</he> in order that his mind be elevated (that he may not feel himself humiliated).—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 37">Ex. R. s. 37</cite> <he>זָחָה דעתו עליו</he> he became overbearing.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a:13">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>אם תָּזוּח דעתו עליו</he> if he become overbearing; a. e.—[Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵇ bot. <he>הזיח</he>, v. next w.]
